entries.note: The courier's collection from the sender, the history's first scan, before the scans in transit.
Each move between J&T's facilities after the collection, the label repeated scan after scan.
The delivering branch's round, after the moves in transit.
"Recolectado" in an English reply: the collection, at the same instant and place.
"En tránsito" in an English reply, repeated scan after scan.
"En ruta de entrega" in an English reply: the round, at the same instant and place, not the delivery.
